subtle.title: Astra A: subtle facial definition
subtle.scenePrompt: Use image 1 as the identity reference for Vaan Astra. Preserve his face and permanent traits; the current story appearance controls hair, clothes and pose. Use image 2 as the identity reference for Astra Elysia. Preserve her face and permanent traits; the current scene appearance controls clothes and pose. Vaan turns toward Astra in startled recognition as she stands in the open bedroom doorway. Characters: Vaan Astra, one clean-shaven young adult man, violet hair and golden eyes in this life, black and gold tailored coat and white gloves; Astra Elysia, one adult woman, long black hair, black tailored clothes and feathered mantle. Exactly these two people. Camera: medium two-shot, slightly low angle. Vaan foreground left turns toward Astra in the doorway right, both faces readable and distinct, expressive eyes and brows. Location: the existing luxurious bedroom, silk-covered four-poster bed, battle tapestries, stained-glass windows, reddish-brown desk and velvet armchair. Lighting: amber window light models their faces and clothing, with cooler blue sky notes outside the windows. Astra Elysia only: preserve the original reference identity and adult age. Give her face a gently tapered oval outline rather than a round, puffy cheek silhouette, with modest cheekbone definition and a clean, softly angular jaw. Add precise drawn upper eyelids, inner eye corners, iris and pupil separation, a small defined nose bridge, and clear lip corners. Use restrained cel shading beneath her cheekbones and jaw. Keep her expression intent and composed, with natural youthful adult proportions and warm skin. Keep the existing Vaan description and facial rendering unchanged. Do not add facial wrinkles, extra jewelry, photographic pores or a new illustration style. Style: Korean full-color fantasy manhwa: crisp ink line art, cel shading, expressive drawn eyes and faces, vibrant colors and magical glows, richly illustrated environments, 2D animation keyframe aesthetic. No photographic skin, live action, 3D render or four-panel collage. Production constraints: Use only the people selected for this shot. Preserve their canonical identity and current scene clothing. Fully illustrated 2D manhwa, one continuous landscape scene at one moment. No title text, labels, captions, borders, collage or extra important people.
